project.title: Enriched anammox lab reactor experiments Metagenomic assembly
project.description: Candidatus Brocadia sapporoensis was enriched from disrupted granules from a full-scale anammox reactor at Dokhaven-Sluisjesdijk wastewater treatment plant in Rotterdam, the Netherlands (van der Star et al. 2007). The chemostat was fed with a concentrated medium (840 mgN/L of NH4Cl and NaNO2), and operated under NO2- limitation. Trace element solutions were prepared according to van der Star et al. 2008. The pH was controlled with a NaHCO3 to 7.0.

samples: MIMAG Metagenome-assembled Genome sample from Candidatus Brocadia sapporoensis enrichment culture
granules from the full-scale anammox reactor of Dokhaven-Sluisjesdijk wastewater treatment plant, further enriched at TU Delft in a chemostat over two months prior to sampling
